entries.zh: 慌忙；急急忙忙、不加思虑地
entries.en: hastily, in a hurry; without deliberation (sin tiento)

entries.zh: 慌迫；急迫催逼、过分催促
entries.en: to hurry someone excessively, press urgently; importunately

entries.zh: 吟（诵读经文时加抑扬腔调）
entries.notes: 「吟」与 Acentuar la leccion 相合，指诵读经文时的腔调，展开略依赖推断。

entries.zh: 金玉音（字字金玉之言；为语音标声调）
entries.en: golden-jade words; to accent the syllables of a word
entries.notes: 汉字「金玉音」与 acentuar las voces 对应关系非直译，释义依赖推断。

entries.zh: 鉋（刨光、修削；〔原件字头存疑〕）
entries.en: to plane, smooth with a plane (source character uncertain)
entries.notes: 字头栏为 [疑:鉋/敲]，音写 Cáuᶜ 近「鉋」音，采鉋义但存疑。

entries.zh: 鉋刀；刨光的刀（〔首字存疑〕）
entries.notes: 同上承接 [疑:鉋/敲] 刀，按工具义释。

entries.en: to plane smooth and clean (make it plain white)
entries.notes: 「做白地」字面为做成素白地面，作刨光义解依赖语境推断。

entries.en: to accept and receive, take upon oneself

entries.zh: 私；偏私、看人情（不分好歹待人）
entries.notes: 词尾音写 lay giáᶜ（内个别）未见于汉字栏，整体义依赖上下文推断。

entries.zh: 大细心；待人分厚薄高下之心（嫌贫爱富）
entries.en: a heart that makes distinctions (great-small mind); respect of persons
entries.notes: 「大细心」此处作分别心解，非今义细心，依赖 17 世纪语境推断。

entries.zh: 厚薄心；待人分厚薄之心、偏心
entries.en: a heart that weighs thick and thin; favoritism of persons
to hit upon, guess right, be correct

entries.zh: 执着个着；恰好合意、正中其好
entries.en: to hit exactly what pleases; to suit the taste exactly
entries.notes: 「执个着」为口语结构，与 acertar con el gusto 对应关系依赖推断。

entries.en: to guess right (in divination); accurate, effective
to hit the mark, strike the target
